newsitem.title: CHINA: KOREA ZINC'S AUSTRALIAN SUBSIDIARY SETS FRN.
newsitem.headline: KOREA ZINC'S AUSTRALIAN SUBSIDIARY SETS FRN.

text.p: Korea Zinc Co Ltd has mandated Citicorp International to arrange the following issue, lead arranger Citicorp International said on Monday.
The borrower, Sun Metals Corp, is an Australian subsidiary of Korea Zinc Co.
BORROWER SUN METALS CORPORATION PTY LTD
GUARANTOR KOREA LONG TERM CREDIT BANK
AMOUNT US$120 MLN DIVIDED INTO TWO-TRANCHES
(A) US$60 MLN AVAILABLE WITHIN SEVEN DAYS FROM THE
SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT DATE
(B) US$60 MLN AVAILABLE WITHIN NINE MONTHS FROM THE
DATE OF ISSUANCE OF THE FIRST TRANCHE
COUPON 6ML+65BP (YR 1-3), 6ML+80BP (THEREAFTER)
MATURITY 5 YRS PUTS -- CALL YR 3
TYPE SUB FRN ISS PRICE PAR LAUNCH 08.AUG.97
LISTING LUXEMBOURG REPAYMENT BULLET REPLIES 29.AUG.97
RATING ** TAX PROV FREE&CLR DENOMS US$500K

NEG PLG -- CRS DEF YES FORCE MAJ YES
HOME CTRY S.KOREA/AUSTRALIA GOV LAW ENGLISH
PAY DATE MID.SEP.97 PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
MGT LEVELS AND FEES (ALL-IN YIELD)

SECURITIZATION &
INFRASTRUCTURE FUNDING CORP.
NOTES DIRECT, GENERAL AND UNCONDITIONAL. WILL RANK PARI
PASSU.
A COMMITMENT FEE OF 0.2 PCT PER ANNUM ON THE COMMITTED
UNUTILIZED PORTION OF ISSUE AMOUNT FOR THE FIRST SIX
MONTHS OF THE AVAILABILITY PERIOD AND THEREAFTER
STEPPING UP TO 0.65 PCT PER ANNUM, CALCULATED FROM THE
DATE OF THE ISSUANCE OF THE FIRST TRANCHE.
THE FRNs WILL BE REDEEMED IN FULL EITHER (I) UPON FINAL
MATURITY AT PAR, OR (II) UPON CALL DATE AT 100.2.
PROCEEDS WILL BE USED TO FINANCE CONSTRUCTION OF
TOWNSVILLE ZINC REFINERY PROJECT IN QUEENSLAND,
AUSTRALIA.
**THE SUBSCRIPTION OF THE NOTES SHALL BE CONDITIONAL UPON
